propositions: gateway/* providers (gateway/anthropic, gateway/bedrock, gateway/google-cloud, gateway/groq, gateway/openai) incorrectly stamp tier as first_class when no base_url is configured, misrepresenting that requests traversed an intermediary that can rewrite them
a run routed through an opaque gateway without explicit base_url should be marked best_effort to signal lower trust in provenance, not first_class
direct providers without base_url must remain stamped first_class to avoid collateral damage to existing behavior
gateway provider detection must use set membership against a registry of known gateway ids, not prefix matching, to enforce architectural constraints
endpoint_host should remain None for gateway providers unless base_url is explicitly configured, as it reports configured values not synthesized ones
